Context: 1. On re-employment in civil posts under Central Government.-

## 1. On re-employment in civil posts under Central Government.-  
- (i) Employees who had retired on superannuation / retirement pension are NOT eligible for confirmation and pensionary benefits for re-employed service. They are taken as temporary employees.
- (ii) Employees who retired on compensation pension (gratuity) or invalid pension (gratuity) was re-employed and appointed on or before 31-12-2003 to a service or post are eligible for confirmation.
